acf.heading: Research-use and store policies.
acf.intro: One permanent page for the policies that support the storefront, checkout, and product pages.
acf.review_note: The structure below is built, but the wording is intentionally marked as preview content. Lion RUO should supply or approve final legal, compliance, shipping, privacy, and return language before the site goes live.

sections.title: Research Use Only Policy
paragraphs: Preview copy: products on this site are presented solely for laboratory and in-vitro research use. Final purchaser qualifications, prohibited uses, jurisdiction restrictions, and any required acknowledgements should be supplied or approved by Lion RUO before launch.
items: No medical, dosing, administration, or therapeutic guidance is provided by this page structure.
Product and testing statements should match the documentation for the applicable lot.

sections.title: Terms of Sale & Use
paragraphs: Preview copy: this section is reserved for the conditions that govern access to the site, order requests, purchaser responsibilities, accepted uses, order acceptance, pricing corrections, and other commercial terms.
items: Final terms should define when an order request becomes an accepted order.
Any purchaser certification or research-use acknowledgement should be reviewed before production.

sections.title: Privacy Policy
paragraphs: Preview copy: this section will describe what information the site collects through contact forms, newsletter signup, checkout, analytics, and other services; why that information is collected; and how it is handled.
items: The final policy should reflect the actual services enabled at launch, including WordPress, Vercel, Resend, analytics, or other providers.

sections.title: Shipping Policy
paragraphs: Preview copy: this section is reserved for confirmed processing times, shipping methods, geographic availability, tracking, packaging, lost-package procedures, and any temperature or handling statements the client approves.

sections.title: Returns & Refunds
paragraphs: Preview copy: this section will explain eligibility for returns, damaged or incorrect shipments, reporting windows, replacement or refund procedures, and any products that cannot be returned.
